entities.name: Baha ad-Din Shoieb
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bahāʾ al-Dīn Abū al-Maḥāsin Yūsuf ibn Rāfiʿ ibn Tamīm was a 12th-century Arabic jurist, scholar and historian notable for writing a biography of Saladin whom he knew well.
